{{Otheruses|Darth Vader}}
[[File:Darth-vader-statuette.jpg|250px|thumb|The statuette]]
Since at least the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall '''Darth Vader statuette''' made in the likeness of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], was created and distributed throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When someone approached the general area of the statue from within a twelve-meter distance from the statue, the statue played a full recording of [[The Imperial March (Martial music)|The Imperial March]]. [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]] had collected some of these statuettes. The statue's base was [[Color/Legends|colored]] light metallic blue and featured the [[Imperial crest/Legends|insignia]] of the Galactic Empire throughout the sides of the statue.

==Behind the scenes==
The Darth Vader statuette was a lootable no trade item that could be acquired in the MMORPG game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. They could acquire the item with the TCG card 2SWGP4.
